data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

  • Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

  • Expand our newer Infisical PKI, Infisical PAM, and Infisical KMS product lines.

  • Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

  • A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

Nice to have

  • Expertise in Go.

  • Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

  • Previous founder or startup experience.

  • Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/full-stack-engineer-infisical

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Join the innovative Grid Automation Technology team! We are seeking an experienced embedded DSP Developer to join our dynamic team in creating the building blocks to enable digital transformation in the power grid, focused on signal digitization, protection & control infrastructure devices!

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of embedded systems architecture with DSP, software and hardware architectures, and protection application knowledge within the Transmission & Distribution power-system domain. You will be responsible for executing a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of embedded systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. This process proceeds from concept to production to operation, based on strategies for the power industry.

As part of a multi-developer firmware team the major responsibilities will include architecture, analysis, design of embedded solutions for Square/UR product line. The Senior Staff Developer – Embedded SW Development will report to the Senior Embedded SW Manager.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Analyze complex challenging requirements to architect effective DSP design solutions making up the overall system architecture including hardware, embedded DSP software, software tools, V&V and test rigs.
  • Provide forward-looking strategies for platforms and technology development, technical risks elimination and insertion, in order to make the platform reliable and the product competitive.
  • Drive platform reuse strategies. Making data-driven decisions using defined trade-off criteria.
  • Facilitate, drive discussions and steer cross-functional councils to solve issues, drive decisions, gain consensus, and align on technical risk mitigation strategies.
  • Communicate complex messages and negotiate with others to adopt a different point of view. Influence peers to take action and negotiate with external partners and vendors.
  • Utilize in-depth understanding of key technology challenges to accomplish own work and provide direction to cross-functional teams.
  • Application of technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems, using multiple internal sources and some external sources to arrive at decisions.
  • Define architecture enablers and collaborate with ART Product Owners and Product Managers on backlog definition and prioritization.
  • Provide timely communications on significant issues, risks and/or developments. Maintaining a focus on safety, reliability, performance, and security for embedded systems.
  • Capture and elicit detailed requirements from stakeholders to ensure comprehensive understanding and documentation.
  • Handle change management and impact analysis. Assessing the effects of modifications on system architecture.
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. Explain difficult information and work to build consensus. Use persuasion skills to influence others on topics within field.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering
  • Minimum of 10 years software development experience
  • A minimum of 8 years of DSP algorithm design and implementation experience is a must (FFT, IIR, FIR)
  • Experience with microprocessors and microcontrollers
  • Experience with embedded software development, Assembly, C/C++, VxWorks, Linux, ARM, SHARC, 67xx.
  • Experience in code optimization and efficiency improvements
  • Experience using emulators, simulators and software analysis tools
  • Knowledge of MATLAB will be an added advantage

data.description:
About Keystone

Keystone is one of the largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerages in the country — ranked #26 among U.S. retail brokers and #4 fastest-growing in the Top 50 by Business Insurance. Our platform spans 33+ states, 180+ agency partners, and more than $500 million in revenue — uniting some of the country's most respected independent agencies with the scale, tools, and resources of a national brokerage. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are — their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Data Visualization Engineer

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Data Visualization Engineer with hands-on experience building enterprise-grade business intelligence solutions and a strong passion for applying AI and Generative AI capabilities to analytics, visualization, dashboards, and reporting. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, Power Query, and data visualization, while also being comfortable using AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, identify insights, enhance user experiences, and enable business users to interact with data more naturally.

This individual reports to the VP of Data & Analytics and will partner closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and analytics leaders to transform complex data into intuitive, actionable insights and scalable self-service analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Visualization & Analytics

  • Design, develop, and maintain sophisticated Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical applications for business and executive audiences.
  • Translate complex business requirements into intuitive and actionable analytical experiences.
  • Develop scalable semantic models, measures, calculated columns, and business logic using DAX.
  • Build efficient data transformations using Power Query.
  • Apply appropriate dimensional modeling techniques, including star schema, fact and dimension design, hierarchies, and reusable semantic models.
  • Design dashboards using strong principles of data visualization, UX/UI, information hierarchy, and data storytelling.
  • Optimize Power BI solutions for performance, scalability, usability, and maintainability.
  • Implement drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips, dynamic measures, field parameters, conditional formatting, and other advanced Power BI capabilities where appropriate.

AI-Enabled Business Intelligence

  • Use AI and Generative AI tools to accelerate dashboard and report development, requirements interpretation, DAX development, documentation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Leverage AI-assisted analytical capabilities to help identify patterns, anomalies, trends, correlations, and business insights within enterprise data.
  • Create intuitive analytical experiences that allow users to move beyond static reporting toward conversational and AI-assisted data exploration.
  • Understand how to formulate effective prompts and business questions to obtain reliable analytical results from AI-powered tools.
  • Explore appropriate use of natural-language querying, AI-generated narratives, automated summaries, anomaly detection, forecasting, and intelligent visualization recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual reporting effort and improve analyst and business-user productivity.
  • Help establish reusable patterns and best practices for responsible AI adoption within BI and analytics.
  • Stay current with advancements in AI-enabled analytics and recommend capabilities that can provide measurable business value.

Data Integration & Engineering

  • Connect Power BI to data from cloud platforms, databases, APIs, data warehouses, lakehouses, Excel/SharePoint sources, and other enterprise applications.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to define appropriate datasets and data models for analytics consumption.
  • Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting to ensure dashboard accuracy.
  • Develop efficient incremental refresh and data refresh strategies.
  • Understand upstream/downstream data dependencies and assist with root-cause analysis of data-quality issues.

Governance, Security & Deployment

  • Implement appropriate Row-Level Security (RLS) and data-access controls.
  • Follow organizational standards for workspace management, deployment, naming conventions, documentation, and governance.
  • Participate in development, testing, deployment, and production-support processes.
  • Promote reusable datasets and governed semantic models rather than creating unnecessary duplicate data models.
  • Partner with data governance and security teams to ensure appropriate handling of sensitive or confidential information.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field required
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Data Visualization
  • Proven hands-on experience developing and maintaining solutions using Microsoft Power BI
  • Strong SQL skills, with the ability to write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex queries
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies
  • Experience designing dimensional data models and enterprise semantic models
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize Power BI reports and datasets for performance
  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and reconciliation
  • Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into effective analytical solutions
  • Demonstrated proficiency using Generative AI or AI-assisted tools in analytics and BI workflows
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated output for accuracy and business context
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical reasoning skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts and data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check, as permitted by law

Remote Work Environment: Preference given to candidates in Eastern or Central U.S. time zones

Salary Transparency Statement: In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws, we will provide the applicable salary range upon request to candidates who reside in jurisdictions where such disclosure is required.

You know how to define strict system boundaries and executable contracts that constrain AI agents, ensuring they accelerate code generation without introducing architectural drift or spaghetti code.

data.description:
About Yaqeen Institute

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We work to dismantle doubts through well-researched truths, nurture conviction by strengthening belief with practical, spiritual guidance, and inspire contribution by reviving our tradition of faithful changemakers, insha’Allah. We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. You will design, build, and operate the data platform that powers analytics, research, and product decisions across the organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable modeling complex datasets, engineering resilient pipelines, and managing the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will own systems from ingestion and transformation through to the warehouse layer, and you will set the standards that keep our data trustworthy. Beyond building, you will partner closely with analytics, product, and platform teams to define how data moves through the organization and to raise the bar for reliability, quality, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modelling & Transformation

  • Model and structure data for analytical and operational use, owning the transformation layer and its tooling, including dbt
  • Design data models that are clear, well documented, and easy for downstream teams to build on
  • Define and enforce data contracts and schema standards in collaboration with upstream and downstream engineering teams

Pipelines & Orchestration

  • Design and build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines across ETL, ELT, and change data capture patterns
  • Orchestrate and schedule workflows using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Ensure pipelines are observable, recoverable, and well instrumented, with monitoring and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach consumers

Data Warehousing & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize our modern data warehouse, including storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, and manage deployment and container orchestration
  • Implement privacy, anonymization, and governance controls to keep sensitive data protected and compliant

Collaboration & Communication

  • Participate in planning and requirements discussions to raise data quality and modeling concerns before development starts
  • Translate requirements from analysts, researchers, and product engineers into robust data models and reliable delivery
  • Keep engineering and the wider organization connected through transparent, timely communication

Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL, including performance tuning and complex analytical query design
  • Advanced Python for pipeline development, tooling, and automation
  • Familiarity and hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or an equivalent
  • Data warehousing: expert knowledge of one modern platform (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift), including architecture, storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Experience developing and orchestrating data pipelines across ETL, ELT, CDC, and stream processing
  • Data modeling and tooling expertise, including dbt
  • Experience with modern orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure tooling, including Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes or equivalent
  • Experience defining and enforcing data contracts or schema standards in collaborative engineering environments
  • Exposure to privacy and anonymization implementations
  • Background in a SaaS, startup, or product-led environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with data observability and lineage tooling such as Sentry or Datadog is a plus

Assignment

  • Technical assessment assigned after candidate screening.

Yaqeen Institute embraces a philosophy that values and promotes diversity. Our goal is to attract, develop, retain, and advance a talented and diverse workforce within a culture where all employees are empowered to reach their fullest potential.

Please note that all career opportunities at Yaqeen Institute are subject to a three-month probationary period, during which we assess performance, alignment with our values, and mutual fit to ensure long-term success in the role.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Software Engineer - Argentina
data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This role is remote, so it can be executed globally.

About the role

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do:

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

  • Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Requirements

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

Location

  • This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Argentina, with a preference of Buenos Aires. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/forward-deployed-engineer-software-engineer-argentina-elevenlabs

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

data.title: Backend Engineer, Agent Tools (LATAM)
data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

Team & position summary

We are looking for a Software Engineer, API Integrations to join TRM’s AI Engineering team, focused on building the third-party integrations and scalable integration platform that power our AI-native products. You will design and ship reliable connectors, APIs, services, and integration infrastructure that allow TRM’s AI systems to access external data sources safely, quickly, and at scale.

In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product managers, data teams, and internal users to turn integration needs into production-grade systems. You will help improve the speed, quality, and reliability of how TRM connects to external intelligence sources, ultimately supporting our mission to build a safer financial system for the world.

The impact you will have:

  • Design, build, and maintain third-party API integrations that power TRM’s Agentic products and workflows.

  • Develop scalable integration infrastructure, shared services, and internal tooling that make it faster and safer to add new data sources.

  • Build reliable APIs, backend services, and data pipelines that support high-volume, mission-critical product experiences.

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, data, and internal stakeholders to translate integration needs into clear technical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Improve the quality, observability, reliability, and maintainability of TRM’s integration platform as usage grows across the business.

What we’re looking for:

  • Experience designing and building scalable backend systems, APIs, web services, and production software.

  • Strong understanding of third-party API integration patterns, including authentication, rate limits, retries, error handling, data normalization, and monitoring.

  • Experience with storage systems such as relational databases, analytical databases, queues, caches, or event-driven architectures.

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, structure complex problems, and identify the highest-impact technical priorities.

  • Strong ownership mindset and comfort driving projects from vague requirements through production launch and iteration.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working collaboratively in a cross-functional environment with product, design, data, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.

  • Experience with OSINT data sources a plus

  • Experience with AI Production Systems a plus

About the Team:

  • The AI Engineering team builds the systems, workflows, and infrastructure behind TRM’s AI-native products. This role sits on the team focused on third-party integrations and the scalable platform that enables TRM to connect to external data sources quickly, reliably, and securely.

  • The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Engineers are expected to lead projects as technical anchors and are given opportunities to grow ownership according to their level and goals.

  • We work closely with product, design, data platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to deliver capabilities that directly impact customers and internal users.

  • The team’s culture is built on psychological safety, high ownership, trust, accountability, and a bias toward shipping useful systems quickly.

  • The team’s timezone is a mix of EST and PST, with at least 6 hours of overlap with PST, generally from 8 am to 2 pm PST.

  • On-call: We have an on-call rotation that is approximately one week long and occurs once every 4–6 weeks. On-call work includes responding to PagerDuty alerts that warrant immediate attention and triaging customer or internal support requests from designated Slack channels.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

The team is often tasked with delivering critical integration work on tight timelines. In one example, a project initially estimated to take two months was delivered in two weeks by ruthlessly prioritizing, bringing in the right implementation support, and partnering with product to descope the first milestone while preserving immediate customer value. The project was able to deliver value quickly in sales conversations while the team continued to iterate on future milestones.

  • Engineers at TRM are empowered to drive decision-making across product, design, and technical implementation. Rather than waiting days for alignment, engineers are expected to analyze tradeoffs, propose solutions, and move discussions toward clear decisions.

    The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

    • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

    • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

    • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

  • TRM has a large group of internal power users who provide fast product feedback. When engineers identify a clear pain point from this group, they are empowered to ship targeted improvements directly to beta users without multiple layers of approval.

  • In this role, speed means building integrations that are useful quickly, then hardening them into scalable, observable, and reusable platform capabilities as usage grows.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

data.title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (Paris or Remote France)

experience_requirements.text: 3+ years of experience

data.description:
About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre, Engineering Manager.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.

About the job

  • Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.
  • Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.
  • Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

You will work with

  • Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.
  • Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro.
  • Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.
  • Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.
  • Back-end: Python, FastAPI.
  • Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript, with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.
  • You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.
  • You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.
  • Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.
  • Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.
  • Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

data.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this, our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.com to learn more about us.

As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.

The Health Plans Software Engineering group builds the products that help health plans keep provider data accurate. It is made up of two product teams, one focused on roster automation and one focused on directory accuracy. Directory Accuracy owns the master data management and client data integration side of that work: the data platform that ingests, matches and standardizes client data to support provider directory accuracy, site feasibility, and healthcare professional credentialing. The core loop is: client entity intake, unique ID assignment, entity matching against H1's core data layer, then sync back into client feeds and pipelines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Health Plans team, you'll design, build, and run the big data pipelines and services behind products our health plan and life sciences customers rely on every day. We're expanding beyond pipelines into customer-facing applications and internal tools, so the data we build becomes products customers can see and use. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to writing code in PySpark, Scala and SQL, solving hard data problems at scale, and shipping features that customers and internal teams use directly. You'll join an established team of a Staff engineer, a Senior engineer and two contractors, and report to the Director of Software Engineering, Health Plans.

You will:
- Design, build and operate large-scale data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, matching and syncing client data, using PySpark, Scala and SQL
- Build and improve the entity matching service that resolves client records against H1's core data layer, including its underlying schema
- Develop data asset management features such as scoring, status assignment and configurable intake
- Build the APIs and backend services that power customer-facing UIs and internal tools, making pipeline outputs easy to explore, act on and trust
- Contribute to customer-facing and internal applications that help bring new products to market
- Build self-service internal tools that let operations, customer success and other non-technical teams work with data without engineering help
- Work directly with messy enterprise client data, debugging issues end to end and making ingestion more reliable and repeatable
- Integrate clinical and provider data as new products and customers come onto the platform
- Work with product and design partners to shape features from customer problem through shipped product
- Improve pipeline performance, reliability, observability, testing and documentation
- Contribute to architecture decisions and design and code reviews
- Collaborate with adjacent teams that own feed delivery, access infrastructure, public-facing APIs and roster processing

ABOUT YOU

You're a senior big data engineer who loves building products, not just pipelines. You care about how data reaches the people who use it, whether that's a customer in our app or a teammate using an internal tool. You're happiest deep in the code, tuning Spark jobs, untangling messy source data and shipping features customers notice. You take ownership of systems end to end and know how to make an existing codebase better. You do well in fast-moving environments and communicate clearly with engineers, product partners and non-technical stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS 

- 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on data engineering and building data-driven products
- Deep experience designing, building and running production big data pipelines at scale (ETL/ELT, orchestration, scheduling, monitoring)
- Strong proficiency in PySpark, Scala, Python and SQL
- Solid experience with distributed data processing and performance tuning in Spark
- Experience building APIs or backend services that support customer-facing applications
- Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP or Azure)
- Hands-on experience with entity resolution, record matching or master data management
- Experience with data quality, scoring or validation frameworks
- Comfort working directly with client data, including messy source files, and onboarding enterprise customers
- Product-engineering mindset: you care about how customers use what you build
- Preferred: full-stack experience, or experience building web UIs with a modern framework (e.g., React)
- Preferred: experience building products that turn complex data into customer-facing features
- Preferred: experience building internal self-service tools
- Preferred: experience with healthcare data such as provider or HCP directories, rosters, credentialing, clinical trial or site feasibility data
- Preferred: experience with CTMS or other clinical systems data

COMPENSATION

This role pays $185,000 to $230,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSU).

The ideal candidate will be able to independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, identify automation opportunities, plan and implement automation efforts, drive technical work through completion, and collaborate across infrastructure, security, cloud, database, network, storage, and application teams.

Processes automation (30%)

  • Remediate vulnerabilities and security findings within defined SLAs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with infrastructure migrations, cloud initiatives, or data center modernization.

data.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
data.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform. 

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

Role Purpose

Matillion has a SaaS first approach with a diverse set of technology stacks across multiple pillars. As part of the Security & IT function, this role will be responsible for engineering, automating, and optimising the core systems that support the Matillion user base.

The Senior IT Engineer plays a pivotal role in evolving IT services across the organization. This role is multi-faceted, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic approach to removing friction from traditional IT processes through relentless automation. The incumbent will be responsible for administering and enhancing core business systems and support processes, leveraging no-code tools to drive efficiency. As the core representative of the IT Service Desk,  this individual will set a benchmark for technical excellence and process improvement.

This role is essential in ensuring optimal system performance and the continuous improvement of IT solutions. The goal is to build a scalable, automated, and user-centric IT environment that supports our global business operations.

What will you be doing?

IT Systems Automation

  • Act as the final technical authority and escalation point for complex issues related to core systems and processes.

  • Relentlessly automate manual processes across all systems, particularly user lifecycle management (onboarding/offboarding), using no-code tools and scripting.

  • Own the technical delivery and stability of high-profile, company-wide events (e.g., All Hands) hosted on Zoom.

Process Automation & Optimization

  • Collaborate with internal teams (like People & Culture and Security) to remove friction from key business processes, re-engineering workflows for speed and efficiency.

  • Proactively analyse support ticket trends to identify and eliminate entire classes of service requests through automation or system improvements.

  • Own and automate the monitoring of hardware and SaaS compliance, ensuring all systems align with business and security standards.

  • Maintain and build a comprehensive knowledge base, documenting system architecture, processes, and automation workflows.

Leadership & Incident Management

  • As the core IT representative in the office, provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance on engineering best practices.

  • Act as the primary technical lead for incidents impacting core systems, assuming the role of Incident Commander as required.

  • Own the problem management lifecycle: identify recurring incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and engineer permanent solutions to prevent reoccurrence.

  • Lead and participate in IT improvement projects, with a strong focus on strategic automation initiatives.

What are we looking for?

 Skills Required

  • Deep technical expertise in engineering, administering, and automating cloud-based and physical IT infrastructure, including: Okta (or similar IdP), Google Workspace, Atlassian Suite, Zoom, Slack, Jamf (macOS/iOS), and Intune (Windows/Android).

  • A proven track record of proactively identifying and eliminating technical friction by engineering automated solutions, moving beyond simple ticket resolution.

  • Strong experience with no-code automation tools (e.g., N8n, Zapier, Workato) or scripting (e.g., Python, GAM) to build and maintain efficient workflows.

  • Demonstrated experience in technical mentorship and a strong capability for leadership, acting as a technical authority and guide.

  • Excellent understanding of user lifecycle processes (onboarding/offboarding) and compliance management, with direct experience in automating these workflows.

  • Experience in managing vendor relationships and acting as the final point of escalation for complex technical issues.

  • Proficiency in incident and problem management, with a focus on root cause analysis and engineering permanent fixes. Experience acting as an Incident Commander is highly desirable.

  • Experience in leading technical projects and managing initiatives from conception to completion.

  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (GCP, Azure), Identity (Okta), or key SaaS products are a significant plus.

  • Confidence to engage and drive technical conversations with diverse audiences. 

  • Proven ability to prioritise and manage multiple engineering projects and competing priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Personal Capabilities

  • The ability to work one-on-one with users as well as within a support team

  • Good listener who understands a technical issue to provide clear, unambiguous feedback

  • A real problem solver, able to function in a very fast-paced environment.

  • A mindset around continuous improvement, not only in business processes and improving automation but also within themselves

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, delivering high-quality results in a timely manner.

More about Matillion

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:

  • Company Equity
  • 27 days paid time off
  • 12 days of Company Holiday
  • 5 days paid volunteering leave
  • Group Mediclaim (GMC)

Your Safety

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to matillion.com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion.com.

Want to know more?

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at talent@matillion.com.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth & Experimentation – Krak
data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team.

Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products.

The opportunity

  • Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects.

  • Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets.

  • Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live.

  • Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering.

  • Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is.

  • Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential.

  • Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit.

  • Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust.

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows.

  • Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show.

  • End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities.

Nice to haves

  • Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto.

  • Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts.

  • Rust experience, given our backend stack.

  • SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data.

  • AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach.

  • Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

data.title: Fullstack Engineer
data.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer at Kpler, you will play a central role in designing, building, and operating responsive web applications and backend APIs that deliver real-time trade intelligence to global market leaders. Working across frontend user interfaces and microservice architectures, you will turn complex datasets into intuitive, high-impact features. Your contributions will directly enhance how clients interact with critical maritime analytics, driving data-driven decisions across global supply chains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, scale, and maintain modern web applications using TypeScript with modern frontend frameworks (Vue, React) and Python (FastAPI).

  • Design and implement high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs that efficiently stream real-time global trade data.

  • Own feature delivery end-to-end, from early technical scoping and data modeling to deployment, monitoring, and production support.

  • Maintain software quality, observability, and system reliability across cloud infrastructure on AWS using Docker, CI/CD, and Datadog.

  • Integrate modern AI-assisted engineering workflows (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Claude) to accelerate feature development and streamline code maintenance.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and peer Engineers to translate product vision into scalable software.

Experience & Background

What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 3+ years of professional full-stack software development experience building and maintaining production web applications.

  • Working knowledge of Typescript/Javascript, Vue, React and familiarity with micro front end architectures.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building backend microservices and APIs with Python (FastAPI) or Node.js.

  • Practical experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS), containerization (Docker), and automated CI/CD pipelines.

  • Strong fundamentals in relational or NoSQL database design, API design patterns, and automated testing practices.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and workflows.

    • Exposure to GraphQL, Datadog monitoring, or event-driven backend systems.

    • Interest or background in maritime logistics, energy markets, or global supply chain datasets.

We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.

Our People Pledge

Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the Staff Privacy Notice

data.title: Systems Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Are you looking for a role where you're critical to every part of the business? Do you want to help ensure that our teams deliver software so that our analysts can deliver service to our customers? How about being a crucial part of making sure our internal teams operate efficiently?

You're not afraid of new technology. In fact, you love diving in and figuring out how it works. Whether it's a successful launch or a few bumps in the road, you're always up for a challenge. Balancing multiple projects at once is no easy feat, but when everything clicks into place, there's nothing quite like that sense of satisfaction.

The best part of the job? Seeing someone use a capability you've built and hearing them exclaim, "Wow, I can't believe how easy that was." You care about the success of your colleagues and take pride in helping them achieve it.

As a cloud-based IT organization, we're breaking the traditional mold and thinking creatively about how we can make the day-to-day life of our employees simple. We're always looking for innovative solutions, and we need someone with the wit and determination to help us achieve our goals.

In this role, you'll keep Expel's IT infrastructure and services secure and highly available, from our cloud platforms all the way down to the equipment in our conference rooms. You'll manage access across the employee lifecycle, own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end, and take manual work out of how we operate before anyone feels the friction. It's based onsite at our Herndon, Virginia headquarters, so you'll also be the person who makes sure the technology people walk up and touch works exactly like it should.

If you're up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!

What Expel Can Do For You

  • Provide the autonomy to define problems and propose solutions.
  • Deliver never-ending opportunities to tackle business problems.
  • Give you real ownership of large cross-functional projects, end to end.
  • Surround you with a team of problem solvers.
  • Ensure you get support, mentoring, and feedback to make you successful.

What You Can Do For Expel

  • Manage and maintain IT systems in a cloud first environment.
  • Provide friendly and unflappable technical support.
  • Make sure new hires have the accounts, access, and hardware they need on day one, and that access goes away promptly when people leave.
  • Be the point of contact for the systems and services you own.
  • Own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify integration issues, solve errors, and optimize performance.
  • Proactively find opportunities for improvement and build automations that streamline operations and reduce manual work.
  • Apply AI tooling, like Claude and Gemini, to accelerate day-to-day work.
  • Manage IT-owned technology at Expel's HQ, including network equipment, conference room and AV equipment, kiosk computers, and other shared-space systems.
  • Keep people in the loop on service disruptions and changes.
  • Work alongside our security team to protect our information.
  • Contribute to the team's roadmap and work in two week sprints against quarterly and yearly goals.
  • Build and routinely update documentation on automations, configurations, and operating procedures.

What You Should Bring With You

  • Proficiency managing core enterprise SaaS products such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
  • Experience automating tasks and integrating systems using platforms like Workato, Okta Workflows, or Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Experience with AI platforms like Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including prompt engineering and connecting systems through emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Knowledge of concepts like SAML, OIDC, SCIM, REST APIs, webhooks, JWT, and OAuth 2.0.
  • Knowledge of programming and scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ruby.
  • macOS and Windows operating system administration skills, including experience with MDMs like Jamf and Intune.
  • Familiarity with conference room AV and shared-space technology, like Zoom Rooms and Neat devices.
  • Knowledge of Cisco Meraki and basic networking concepts like VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless networking.
  • Strong project management skills, especially on large cross-functional projects.
  • Capacity to balance a mix of urgent, interrupt-driven tasks and project-level work.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, written and verbal, with a habit of treating colleagues like customers.
  • Adept at translating technical concepts and communicating to non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding problem solving abilities, with a desire to get to the root of sophisticated issues.
  • Well-versed in IT operations best practices.
  • 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity.
  • A college degree or credible panache.

Additional Notes

This is a fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. While proximity to our Herndon, Virginia headquarters is a plus for occasional onsite needs, it is not required.

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $105,000 and $125,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

data.title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 3 years of hands-on experience

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.
